topic: Template Class Specialization and SFINAE in Modern C++
explanation: In modern C++, template class specialization combined with SFINAE (Substitution Failure Is Not An Error) allows developers to create flexible and type-safe class templates that adapt their behavior based on template parameters. This technique enables compile-time selection of class implementations, facilitating generic programming and enabling advanced metaprogramming patterns without runtime overhead.
keywords: SFINAE, Template Specialization, C++ Metaprogramming, enable_if
